Karnataka CM links fearless journalism to principled professionals

Karnataka Chief Minister Shivakumar stated that principled professionals are essential for fearless journalism. He emphasized the importance of integrity and professionalism in the media's role. This statement highlights the perceived connection between ethical conduct and the ability of journalists to report without fear.
